Rows are keyed by job number and date (a repeat creates no duplicate); a concurrent Sync now is refused as already running; unmatched rows stay in the queue and attach to equipment after Admin maps them without duplicates

Admin ZMMS page: sync times and Sync now, health with last success and a synthetic failed run, recent runs, equipment mapping with an ignore entry, unmatched queue, job type and status mapping, status evaluation; Management and EQ Team get 403

Back to automatic never sets a missing value: when today's evaluation stopped at unmapped values (RTG-DEMO-06, WireRope not mapped) it keeps the corrected value as awaiting today's ZMMS sync instead of applying a null status; with a computed evaluation it applies that value [Repair-R02B finding 3]

Prediction = replaced date + expected life (calendar months); Original uses the commissioning date; unknown commissioning date or life shows no prediction and never a fabricated date; due soon (90 days) and overdue flags are correct (independent recomputation)

Admin selects major spare parts per position with an expected life by type and a per-equipment override; the override changes only that equipment (another QC from the same template keeps its own register); undesignating hides the row but keeps history

Completing a Replacement special job writes the condition register in the same commit (brand, model, serial, replaced date from the line, history source jobCompletion); an invalid second line commits nothing at all; a retry with the same key replays and adds no history row
The completion dialog for a Replacement job at a major spare part shows the condition notice and pre-fills nothing it does not know (no invented brand, serial or date)
